title: 1812: the North Side woods and the shore cottonwoods match 1835
items: In 1812 the North Side wood now runs east to the sand at the State Street ridge, with its edge thicket and the wood on the sand beyond, as it does in 1835. Before, it stopped 500 m short.
The shore cottonwood grove at Sixteenth to Eighteenth Street stands in 1812 as 58 young cottonwoods, 11 to 13 m tall, at the same places it stands in 1835.
Where they stood and how tall they were is reconstructed under a new liberty.
